claim: Vercel Labs agent-desktop v1.0.2 ships cross-platform accessibility-tree computer-use fixes
verifiedFacts: GitHub's signed v1.0.2 release is dated October 30, 2026, with platform-specific archives and SHA-256 values.
The changelog documents fixes to macOS accessibility permission guidance and command-host restart, plus a Node launcher performance notice.
The repository describes OS accessibility-tree snapshots with snapshot-qualified refs and a subsequent verification step; it does not embed an LLM.
inference: A read-only, accessibility-tree-first desktop automation audit could complement Seed Loom's governed action receipts.
Independent benchmarks and actual cross-platform QA are necessary before promising token savings or accessibility coverage.
Advisory client problem: Teams cannot reliably audit whether a desktop agent acted on the intended UI element.
Project disposition recommendation only: MelodicBloom/seed-loom, MelodicBloom/agent-runtime-control-center, MelodicBloom/aether; no implementation executed.
significance: A concrete, inspectable desktop-agent interface and error contract offers a bounded integration specimen without building another agent runtime.
assumptions: Accessible UI trees cover enough of target desktop apps for useful audit fixtures.
knownLimitations: Release artifacts were not installed or tested in this run.
Accessibility snapshots and traces may contain sensitive desktop content; no capture was authorized.
